adoption_note: Corrects the A3S empirical boundary and adds a missing-consumer-perturbation result; no actual biological-use instance or experiential target is admitted.

nodes.statement: Freeze one animal, limb, source classes, area-3a ensemble, neighbouring 3b/1 ensemble, consumer perturbation, common event clock, downstream endpoint and admissible collateral pathways before inference.
nodes.scope: Not complete organization, not a unique subject and not an experience-existence gate.
nodes.quantifier: One same-instance tuple at a time.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Cross-study capabilities cannot fill fields of one event tuple.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Copy/switch fixes the response face while changing the downstream reader.

nodes.statement: Yamada 2016 already instantiates a same-experiment DR/SR source-by-3a-versus-3b/1 evoked-response face with stimulation-aligned timing; A3S's broader no-crossed-package wording must be narrowed to consumer-specific causal use.
nodes.domain: The two anaesthetized macaques and reported SEP sites in Yamada 2016.
nodes.scope: Response localization only; no afferent-purity, downstream-use, experiential or ownership conclusion.
nodes.quantifier: The reported conditions and sites, not all primates or events.
nodes.all_premises: Yamada methods/results/limitations and exact published counts.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Small delayed SR responses occur in 3a; LFPs reflect multiple sources; sites are nested in two animals.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Separates a complete response face from a downstream-use face.

nodes.statement: Johnson 2026 establishes chronic area-3a access with one 32-channel array per subject, but the published installation lacks a neighbouring consumer interface; its first structural failure for the requested crossed probe is consumer contrast, followed by unexecuted source intervention and event contract.
nodes.domain: The two reported Johnson 2026 macaque installations and sessions.
nodes.scope: Published platform capability, not impossibility of augmentation or proof of natural-source use.
nodes.all_premises: Johnson methods/results and distinction between within-3a channels and adjacent regions.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: An additional 3b/1 array or validated alternative could repair the contrast prospectively.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Prevents chronic access from being promoted to double-selective use evidence.

nodes.statement: For source s, local response R and downstream endpoint Y, the use target is the endpoint contrast U_s=Y(s,g=1)-Y(s,g=0) under a validated area-3a consumer perturbation g, not the unperturbed source-by-region response interaction.
nodes.domain: Binary or numerical endpoint extensions of one frozen probe contract.
nodes.scope: Causal-use audit target, not familiar mineness or basal experience.
nodes.quantifier: For each fixed source context s and perturbation contract.
nodes.all_premises: Fixed source, consumer perturbation and endpoint semantics.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Spillover or invalid perturbation defeats the target interpretation.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Human-realized-agent and bypass worlds share records while changing readers.

nodes.statement: A complete unperturbed source-by-region response face does not identify U_s when the consumer-perturbed endpoint face is unobserved; with two binary source contexts there are four endpoint completions, including shadow/bypass and endpoint-changing-use witnesses.
nodes.domain: Two source contexts, recorded consumer regions and a binary downstream endpoint.
nodes.scope: Elementary missing-intervention result; no mathematical novelty claim.
nodes.quantifier: For every fixed observed g=0 response and endpoint face without further g=1 constraints.
nodes.all_premises: A3P:USE_TARGET and absence of independently grounded g=1 constraints.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A valid consumer intervention and endpoint observation can remove the specific completion ambiguity.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Copy/switch varies downstream read while preserving every unperturbed record.

nodes.statement: Stop the actual-use inference at the first absent conjunct among local access, monitored source contrast, neighbour consumer contrast, common event binding, validated consumer perturbation and predeclared downstream endpoint; failed manipulation is INVALID_PROTOCOL, not no experience.
nodes.scope: Application inference only; no basal-experience or unique-owner conclusion.
nodes.quantifier: For every evaluated same-instance package, all six conjuncts are required.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Passing the use package still does not name ownership, agency or familiar mineness.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Bounds instrumentation work and returns to the UCT main line.

nodes.statement: If one independently admitted actual process and complete signature include a grounded selected-source-to-area-3a-to-downstream-use relation, C1 permits an experience-internal structural counterpart; familiar mineness, ownership, conceptual I and report require separate bridges.
nodes.domain: One independently admitted actual process and complete signature.
nodes.scope: Positive organization-inside-experience conditional, not a basal gate or exclusive owner.
nodes.quantifier: For each instance satisfying all inherited C1 and grounding premises.
nodes.all_premises: A:C1 plus actual bearer/interval/signature/relation grounding and a separate target bridge.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Equal response or behaviour with a bypass blocks semantic naming.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Returns consumer-use evidence to experience–self without installing a homunculus.

rules.binding: same source contexts, perturbation coding and endpoint semantics
one empirical package cannot borrow a source, neighbour, clock, perturbation or endpoint from another animal/study
rules.joint_witness: capability table and explicit first-failure codes
